title: Client interop naming compatibility scenarios
description: Focused client interop pack for MCP-Geo tool naming, discovery, resource reads, and schema compatibility across 0.8.1-to-0.8.2 style changes.

ambiguous_westminster_data.compatibilityFocus: Checks whether the client discovers the routing/descriptor surface without relying on dotted names only.

tool_search_postcode.compatibilityFocus: Checks whether the client can use tool search/listing and understand sanitized names.

skills_guide_resource.compatibilityFocus: Checks resource reads through URI/name-compatible client behavior.

address_lookup_postcode.compatibilityFocus: Checks canonical dotted, sanitized, and client-prefixed tool-call evidence for a live OS-backed lookup.

static_map_render.compatibilityFocus: Checks whether schema and naming compatibility still leads to the map render descriptor.
